_comment: One unit of competency. It exists as a file because the catalogue lists a unit — and Moodle gets a grade item for it — only once this file ships. The lessons below were READ OFF the built pages' data-criteria, not asserted here, so this cannot drift from what is actually taught.
title: Assemble and check a joint
taughtBy: Marking Out and Cutting a Halving Joint

criteria.text: Dry-fit a joint before glue is applied and correct the fit rather than forcing it.
Explain why an over-tight tenon splits the mortise and a slack one gives a weak joint.
Cramp up an assembly square, checking by measuring both diagonals.
Clean up the assembled work and inspect it against the drawing before it is passed on.
